mapper.sql: p.id, p.purchase_no, p.supplier_id, p.store_id, p.user_id, p.total_amount, p.total_quantity, p.status, p.expect_date, p.audit_time, p.receive_time, p.contact_name, p.contact_phone, p.remark, p.create_by, p.update_by, p.create_time, p.update_time

FROM shop_erp_purchase p LEFT JOIN shop_erp_supplier sp ON sp.id = p.supplier_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_store st ON st.id = p.store_id AND st.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON eu.id = p.user_id
